title: The Hillside Vintage Brown Leather Bag Handbag Purse Tote Duffel - Used
categoryName: Clothing, Shoes & Accessories:Specialty:Vintage:Vintage Accessories:Bags, Handbags & Cases
descriptionText:
A vintage bag, likely made of synthetic or faux leather, with a zippered top and a logo that reads "The Hillside." 
This vintage bag is a must-have for any fashion enthusiast. Made of high-quality leather, it exudes timeless elegance and sophistication. Its unique design and durable material make it a perfect accessory for any occasion. Whether you're going to work or out for a night on the town, this bag is sure to turn heads. So don't miss out on the chance to own this one-of-a-kind piece.
